race.title: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: TARITINO has presumably been freshened up following a busy/productive season on the Flat and could be weighted to add to his hurdles tally. Thriving Seraphic is feared if taking up this engagement, with lightly-raced Gaelic Saint preferred to Maasai Mara among the remainder. TARITINO (IRE) SERAPHIC (IRE) GAELIC SAINT
